Hood.name: Hood
Hood.basicInfo:
Hood, a rare Nomu who learns as he fights. Dark and heavily muscled; a long neck of exposed muscle, a hood of skin over an exposed brain, yellow eyes beneath it.
Speaking Style: A few broken words: an opponent's name, a wish to fight.
Combat Role: Brawler with crushing strength, regeneration, jet-driven flight and arms that reshape into weapons.
Under Pressure: Studies what hurt him and changes approach.
Hood.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Unlike other Nomu he seeks strong opponents and speaks, yet plans nothing beyond the fight. Motivation: A strong opponent. Connections: Tomura Shigaraki and the League of Villains, who release him at a target; from there he fights on his own. Canon voice & behavior: Says a strong hero's name before he charges; never pleads or bargains. Thread: What it takes to burn through his regeneration.
QUIRK: Augmented muscle, Super Regeneration, shoulder jets, shifting arms.
personality: Adaptive: Studies an opponent after each exchange and changes approach.
Battle-hungry: Ignores weak prey when a strong opponent is near.
Callous: Bystanders are terrain to him.
Speaking style: Broken words, a few at a time.
abilities: Augmented muscle: Crushing blows and the bulk to take a top hero's strikes.
Super Regeneration: Regrows lost tissue in seconds; sustained heavy damage outpaces it.
Shoulder jets: Bursts of flight for charges and pursuit.
Shifting arms: Reshapes his arms into weapons mid-fight.
Fighting style: Tests, adapts, closes or escapes on jets and trades blows no person could survive.
Hood.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled creature with dark skin, a long, thick neck of exposed muscle, and a hood-shaped fold of skin arching over the top of the head with the brain exposed beneath it, drawn clean and stylized. Yellow eyes glint under the hood above a wide, toothed mouth. Plain dark trousers. Intent, watchful stare.
